issue_comments.body:
Post-#149 architecture follow-up — executable architecture invariants

Record this as a required composition-first follow-up after PR #149 is accepted and merged. Do not widen #149 for this work.

After #149 merge:

1. Refresh #151 from the new accepted `main` and rerun the repository bootstrap / applicable Stage Research before implementation.
2. Extract the most important composition-first rules that are objectively machine-checkable (roughly the top 10–20 invariants, not the entire prose architecture).
3. Express those rules as the smallest practical executable architecture guards using existing project mechanisms first: structural/static checks, architecture-contract tests, dependency/import checks and CI acceptance.
4. Run these deterministic architecture guards before expensive semantic AI review so obvious architectural drift fails cheaply and reproducibly.
5. Add a new external architecture-linter framework only when the existing repository mechanisms cannot express an important measured rule cleanly. Do not introduce a framework merely for ceremony.

Initial candidate invariants:

```text
CAP trust core
    must not directly depend on concrete reusable substrates
    -> go through the applicable provider / narrow adapter boundary

generic Delegation state
    must not acquire ChatGPT-DOM / MV3 / Temporary-Chat-specific semantics

SessionProvider / DesktopProvider / BrowserProvider / ProcedureProvider / DeviceProvider
    remain the default capability families
    -> do not create per-app or per-site CAP providers by default

BrowserProvider
    -> preserve the accepted generic Playwright/project Browser path first

DesktopProvider
    -> reusable generic Windows/application mechanics first

external substrate accepted/success/invoked/sent/completed
    != CAP PASS
    != whole-task DONE

CAP public semantic surface
    remains exactly six tools unless separately researched and accepted

provider-specific runtime/recovery state
    remains provider evidence and must not silently become CAP authority
```

For #149-derived boundaries, also evaluate narrow executable guards such as:

```text
content-script / browser layer
    may own DOM qualification and bounded extension messaging
    must not bypass directly into filesystem/controller authority

generic control/delegation layer
    must not absorb Temporary-Chat-specific browser state
```

General rule:

```text
architecture requirement
    -> if it can be checked deterministically
    -> encode it as CI/static/structural guard
    -> semantic review should not be the first or only place expected to catch it
```

Do not copy MimiSeek's durable development-failure-pattern registry into CAP by default. For CAP, prefer closing a confirmed failure class by converting the mechanism directly into the strongest practical shared invariant, structural/static guard, architecture contract, and behavioral/adversarial regression. Introduce a durable failure-class registry/state only if later measured evidence shows repeated classes escaping executable guards and a concrete CAP consumer requires cross-change pattern memory. This keeps the #149 `Finding -> Root Cause -> Failure Class -> Repository-wide Search -> Guard` discipline without creating a new registry/framework merely for process ceremony.

Preferred assurance ordering:

```text
deterministic architecture/static guards
    -> ordinary tests / exact-head CI
    -> semantic AI review
    -> physical/runtime acceptance where applicable
```

The intent is to move cheap deterministic rejection ahead of expensive semantic review while preserving semantic review and physical/runtime qualification for defects that cannot be reduced to static structure.

This is a post-#149 architecture-assurance step, not production implementation authorization and not a reason to delay #149 with unrelated scope.

pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Preserve the **composition-first post-#149 architecture** so CAP does not drift into building a large project-owned Agent Runtime or broad execution stacks by default.

This remains a **research/documentation-only Draft PR**. It authorizes no production dependency or implementation.

## Current identity

- BASE: `e810b9dd0006819397e63c1ecc808dd5cceca917`
- HEAD: `7a6c9634c9937081726b42ff4b1d33c047e6f56b`
- branch: `research/prime-runtime-adaptation`
- PR #149: **merged and accepted into main**
- branch refresh after #149: **completed**

The primary direction remains `project-context/COMPOSITION_FIRST_ARCHITECTURE.md`.

## Architecture lock

```text
                         ordinary ChatGPT
                               |
                               v
                         CAP TRUST CORE
              identity / authorization / scope
              logical operation / ExpectedEffect
              ambiguity / reconciliation / provenance
              Verification Kernel / Finish Gate
                               |
       +-----------------------+------------------------+
       |                       |                        |
       v                       v                        v
    Sessions                 Desktop                   IoT
       |                       |                        |
 #149 fresh worker         WinApp CLI            Home Assistant
 CCCC candidate           UFO/UFO²              Matter/MQTT via HA
 Prime optional           OpenAdapt
                          Vision fallback

Browser remains on the accepted Playwright/project boundary unless fresh evidence justifies change.
```

CAP remains the trusted composition kernel rather than the owner of every runtime/executor implementation.

CAP-owned semantics remain stable logical identity, consequence authorization/scope, operation/attempt identity, ExpectedEffect, freshness/provenance, `PASS | FAIL | UNKNOWN`, ambiguous-outcome reconciliation/no blind retry, WorkingState, Verification Kernel, independent Finish Gate, exact source/runtime provenance where required, adapter conformance obligations, and the existing six-tool public authority boundary unless separately accepted.

## Reuse-first rule

Do not build broad project-owned replacements for mature session, desktop, browser, procedure or IoT substrates without a measured conformance gap and fresh Stage Research.

Preferred provider families remain:

```text
SessionProvider
DesktopProvider
BrowserProvider
ProcedureProvider
DeviceProvider
```

Shared CAP invariants sit above them; provider-native state remains native where flattening would lose useful semantics.

## Sessions after merged #149

PR #149 is now frozen as the specialized isolated provider:

```text
fresh / independent / non-personalized / no-plugin / Temporary Chat
```

Do not generalize that mechanism into the persistent-session runtime.

For persistent ordinary ChatGPT, CCCC or an equivalent mature substrate found by fresh research remains the first candidate for target binding, delivery, crash settlement and no-blind-resend mechanics. First prove a transport/session-only profile where shell/git/repo-edit/code-execution mutation paths are physically unavailable outside CAP.

Prime remains off the critical path for basic persistent ChatGPT. Evaluate it only if Composition Stage Research demonstrates a concrete missing primitive such as retained compute/kernel state, subagents, compaction or long-running local loop mechanics.

## Desktop / Browser / Procedures / IoT

Desktop research order remains WinApp CLI/UI Automation first, then UFO/UFO² or another reusable application-aware layer for measured gaps, then structured GUI/synthetic input and selective vision fallback. Do not default to one CAP adapter per Windows application.

Browser remains on the accepted generic Playwright/project path. Site-specific adapters are a last resort after a measured repeatable gap.

OpenAdapt remains the first reuse candidate for demonstration capture/compile/replay mechanics behind CAP evidence and verification boundaries.

IoT production remains deferred until a concrete device consumer exists; Home Assistant remains the preferred first backend candidate.

## Next work

The branch refresh from post-#149 main is complete. The next research sequence is now:

```text
rerun repository skill/bootstrap research context
        ↓
Composition Stage Research
        ├─ Sessions: CCCC/equivalent authority gate + persistent multi-turn/crash tests
        ├─ Desktop: WinApp CLI first + representative application matrix
        ├─ Browser: preserve accepted generic path
        ├─ Procedures: revalidate OpenAdapt roles
        └─ IoT: remain deferred until concrete consumer
        ↓
define adapter conformance obligations
        ↓
implement only thin adapters + CAP-owned remainder
        ↓
custom code only for measured gaps
```

The existing Prime roadmap/addendum, evidence-dependency note, Coddy parking note and verified-skill-distillation parking note remain candidate-specific research material. They do not override the composition-first sequencing.

## Scope lock

Until fresh Stage Research changes the direction:

```text
CAP = trusted composition kernel
      + narrow provider adapters
      + provider conformance / physical acceptance

not

CAP = project-owned implementation of every agent/session/desktop/browser/procedure/IoT runtime
```

No production implementation belongs in this PR yet.

reviews.body:
Post-#149 architecture note / decision reminder:

Do not immediately build a broad CAP-native persistent/existing-session runtime after PR #149. First refresh this Prime branch from accepted main and perform exact-source Prime Stage Research to determine which session-runtime responsibilities should be reused from Prime versus remain CAP-owned.

Key boundary to preserve during that research:

Prime may be allowed to provide session runtime, persistence, supervision/daemon mechanics, attach/detach, retained sessions/workers, and related messaging/runtime mechanics when evidence justifies it.

CAP must retain the trust/transport boundary: opaque exact ChatGPT target/conversation binding, stable delivery/model-request identities, one-shot Send authority, ambiguous-outcome `unknown` state and reconciliation, no blind resend, foreign/wrong-conversation rejection, durable delivery receipt/correlation, source/runtime provenance, authorization, verification and Finish Gate authority.

Only after `ADAPT | KEEP | ADOPT` should a separate Existing-Session Delivery Stage Research define and implement the CAP-owned remainder.

MimiSeek automatic reviewer continuation, Prime MODEL_REQUEST delivery, and later manager wake/resumption must all remain consumers of the same generic capability. Do not introduce MimiSeek-, UV Studio-, GitHub-, repository-, PR-, review-, PASS/FINDINGS-specific routing into CAP.

This note is intentionally metadata-only while #151 remains parked; no production implementation or HEAD change is authorized by it.
